item.title: Jin Ping Mei
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: ititnenon
  • 発売日: 2023-05-20
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 金瓶梅
  • 英語名: Jin Ping Mei

あらすじ

This game is adapted from the classic novel Jin Ping Mei. The protagonist was born in a merchant family. His parents died when he was young and left him a pharmacy. On his 25th birthday, he made a vow: “I will enjoy my life with lots of wives and concubines, and being rich as hell…”
